if args.triage_dry_run:
        # triage_phase returns its report only when triage is configured and
        # has a rollout; otherwise it returns None having written nothing, so
        # report that explicitly to keep one JSON artifact per exit.
        result = triage_phase(config, dry_run=True)
evidence.reason: The `--triage-dry-run` branch calls `triage_phase(config, dry_run=True)` at line 1567 before `service.lock` is acquired at line 1600, so the preview bypasses the serialization that every other repair pass uses. Nothing in the supplied code or comments makes the triage preview lock-free or read-only; the adjacent comment and history establish that triage_phase writes state and consumes a triage budget, so a concurrent drain (running under the lock) and this unlocked preview can both act on the same pending finding, producing a duplicate paid judgment and colliding output/state. The minimal compatible fix is to take `service.lock` before the triage branch (returning `busy` when held), the same guard already used for the `--recover-job`/`--job` paths. This is a routine correctness repair, not an owner-level design change.
